reviews.adminOnlyBody: It affects a whole list or the entire catalog.

kinds.stale_source: Message older than the current price

help.product_match: The name on the list looks like a catalog product, but it is not certain.

help.stale_source: This message is older than the price we already have.
help.mark_unavailable: The full list doesn't include it, or the supplier says it is out of stock.
help.global_change: The supplier announced a change for all their products.
help.tax_basis_changed: The list switched from prices with VAT to prices without VAT (or the other way round).
help.suspicious_instructions: The message tries to give orders to the system. Nothing was applied.
help.unknown_supplier: We couldn't tell for sure which supplier the list is from.
help.extraction_failed: The file or the message could not be processed automatically.
help.column_mapping: This spreadsheet is arriving for the first time: confirm which column to use.

reasons.stated_unavailable: The supplier says it's out of stock

toast.approvedRetriggered: Approved. The list is processed again with what you chose.

errors.stale: The catalog changed since this proposal was made, so it no longer applies. We refreshed the list.
errors.forbidden: Only an administrator can resolve this review.

actions.rejectHint: Nothing changes in the catalog. You can leave a note for the team (optional).
actions.notePlaceholder: E.g.: the supplier made a mistake, I asked for the list again

global.outliers: {count, plural, one {# product exceeds} other {# products exceed}} the configured change limit.

unavailable.missingFromFull: The supplier sent their full list and this product is not on it. They may no longer sell it, or they may have left it out by mistake.
unavailable.statedUnavailable: The supplier says they don't have this product.
unavailable.consequence: If you mark it as unavailable, it stops being offered until they quote it again.

gate.taxBody: This supplier's prices used to come {previous}; this list comes {current}. If you accept it, the list is processed with the new basis.
gate.suspiciousBody: The message includes instructions aimed at the system (for example, changing rules or prices in general). Nothing was applied. Read the original message: if it is a legitimate list, you can process it anyway.
gate.failedBody: It could not be read automatically. If you retry, the list goes back to the queue; if you discard it, nothing happens.
gate.failedBodyDetail: It could not be read automatically ({detail}). If you retry, the list goes back to the queue; if you discard it, nothing happens.

supplier.title: Which supplier is the list from?
supplier.label: Supplier

columns.suspicious: The spreadsheet has text that tries to give orders to the system. Check it before approving.
columns.sheetQuestion: Sheet "{sheet}": which price goes into the catalog?
columns.remembered: It is remembered for this supplier's next spreadsheets with the same format: those are read without AI and without review.

rules.description: How the system behaves, without touching code. Changes apply instantly and are recorded.
rules.readOnly: You can see the rules; changing them is for administrators only.
rules.noChanges: There are no changes to save.

bot.title: Automatic replies
bot.description: What the system answers on its own, without a person stepping in.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.description: Outside business hours, non-urgent WhatsApp summaries wait until opening time and the panel shows "outside business hours". Critical alerts go out anyway.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: When a price change applies on its own, when it alerts and when it asks for a review.

team.title: WhatsApp alerts to the team
team.description: Few messages, and only with what needs action.

contacts.title: Voice notes and opt-outs
contacts.description: Voice note transcription and requests to stop receiving messages.

bot_autoRepliesEnabled.label: The bot replies to contacts
bot_autoRepliesEnabled.help: When off, it replies to nobody (as if every chat were handled by a person). Lists are still processed and the team still gets alerts.

bot_supplierAck.label: Confirm to suppliers that we received their list
bot_supplierAck.help: Sends a "We received your list" message with a summary of what was applied.

coexistence_humanTakeoverMinutes.label: When a person replies, the bot pauses
coexistence_humanTakeoverMinutes.help: In that chat, for this long after the person's last message.

businessHours.label: Days and hours
businessHours.help: Uruguay time. If closing is earlier than opening, the hours continue into the next day.

catalog_priceAlertPct.label: Alert when a price changes
catalog_priceAlertPct.help: It still applies, but an alert is created and it goes into the team summary.

catalog_maxIncreasePct.label: Increases above this go to review
catalog_maxIncreasePct.help: They are not applied until a person approves them.

catalog_maxDecreasePct.label: Decreases above this go to review
catalog_maxDecreasePct.help: A very large decrease is usually a typo.

catalog_lowStockThreshold.label: Alert on low stock
catalog_lowStockThreshold.help: When the supplier reports this stock or less. Empty = no alert.

catalog_autoCreateProducts.label: Create new products automatically
catalog_autoCreateProducts.help: When the AI is sure it is a new product. When off, every new product goes through review.

catalog_reactivateOnQuote.label: Reactivate products when they are quoted again
catalog_reactivateOnQuote.help: An unavailable product becomes available again if it arrives on a list.

notifications_whatsappRecipients.label: Numbers that receive the summaries
notifications_whatsappRecipients.help: With country code, without + or spaces (for example 59899123456). Up to 10. They must have written to the company number before.

notifications_digestWindowMinutes.label: Group alerts over
notifications_digestWindowMinutes.help: Everything that happens in that time arrives in a single message.

notifications_maxPerHour.label: Maximum summaries per hour
notifications_maxPerHour.help: Anything above it joins the next one.

notifications_criticalMaxPerHour.label: Maximum critical alerts per hour
notifications_criticalMaxPerHour.help: Serious errors don't wait for the grouping, up to this limit.

transcription_maxAutoDurationSeconds.label: Transcribe voice notes up to
transcription_maxAutoDurationSeconds.help: Longer ones are left to be listened to by hand (with an alert).

optOut_keywords.label: Words to opt out
optOut_keywords.help: If the message is only one of these (ignoring case and accents). Separate them with commas.

optOut_instructionReminderDays.label: Remind how to opt out every
optOut_instructionReminderDays.help: It is added to the first automatic message and then at most this often.

business_language.label: Language of WhatsApp messages
business_language.help: What the system sends: opt-out replies, supplier confirmations and team summaries. Each person chooses the panel language on their own.

conversations.description: Who wrote, who is answering them and what is still pending.
conversations.search: Search by name, supplier or phone
conversations.noMatchesHint: Try another part of the name or the number.

actions.optInAdminOnly: Recording an opt-in is for administrators only
actions.pauseTitle: Pause the bot in this chat

actions.optOutDone: Opt-out recorded: no more messages are sent to them.
actions.optOutBody: The system stops sending them automatic messages, templates and alerts. If they write to you, a person can still answer.
actions.optInBody: Only if the contact asked to receive messages again (for example, by phone). Who did it and why is recorded.
actions.optOutPlaceholder: E.g.: they called and asked us not to write
actions.optInPlaceholder: E.g.: they asked by email on 9/27

composer.neverWrote: This contact never wrote: WhatsApp doesn't allow starting the conversation without an approved template.
composer.optedOutWarning: They asked not to receive messages. Reply only if it is needed for what they asked you.
composer.label: Your reply
composer.hint: It is sent over WhatsApp as the company. When you reply, the bot pauses in this chat.

optedOut.description: They asked not to receive messages: the system sends them nothing automatic. If they write, a person can answer them.

catalog.noHistory: No price changes to chart yet.
catalog.viewMessage: View the message that changed it
catalog.renameBody: For example, when it was created with the WhatsApp name and the company is called something else. The next lists that state this name are assigned to this supplier. It is recorded.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.nameTaken: Another supplier already has that name. (Merging suppliers comes later.)

alerts.description: What is worth looking at: large increases, low stock, errors. Mark them as seen when you resolve them.
alerts.ackFailed: Could not mark it as seen.

titles.audioTooLongSize: Voice note of {size} MB not transcribed (limit {limit} min): listen by hand

titles.possibleOptOut: Possible opt-out: “{phrase}”. Check it and record it by hand if it applies

users.description: Who signs in to the panel and what they can do. There is always at least one active administrator.
users.updated: User updated. Their open sessions were closed.
users.passwordChanged: Password changed. Their open sessions were closed.
users.passwordHelp: At least 15 characters. A phrase of several words is best (for example, “afternoon coffee at the hardware store”). Give it to the person through a secure channel.
users.createBody: An operator resolves products and conversations; an administrator also handles rules, whole lists and users.
users.name: Name
users.resetBody: All their open sessions are closed: they will have to sign in again.

errors.lastAdmin: The system cannot be left without an active administrator. Make someone else an administrator first.
errors.emailTaken: There is already a user with that email.
errors.ownRole: You can't change your own role or deactivate yourself: another administrator has to do it.
errors.generic: Could not be completed. Try again.

passwordIssues.too_short: At least 15 characters (a phrase of several words is ideal).
passwordIssues.common: It is a known or leaked password: choose another one.
passwordIssues.trivial_pattern: It is a trivial pattern (repetitions or keyboard / number sequences).
passwordIssues.contains_personal_info: It cannot contain the email, the name or the system's name.

foto.title: Send a photo of a price list

pdf.title: Send a supplier PDF

planilla.detail: An Excel file in an already approved format: it is read without AI and at no cost.

planilla_nueva.title: Send a new spreadsheet
planilla_nueva.detail: An Excel file in a format the system doesn't know: a person chooses the price column.

injection.title: Send a prompt-injection message
injection.detail: A message that tries to give orders to the AI: it is stopped and doesn't touch the catalog.

steps.received: Arrived over WhatsApp (simulated, signed like Meta)
steps.extracted: Extracted and checked against the rules

outcomes.suspicious: Stopped for review: the message tries to give orders to the system. The catalog was not touched.
outcomes.newFormat: Spreadsheet in a new format: choose which price column to use.
outcomes.review: It is in Reviews for a person to decide.
outcomes.noChanges: Processed: there were no price changes.
